A map of groups preserving the product.
For a group action and a point x, the subgroup of elements fixing x.
A function on a group that is constant on conjugacy classes.
A homomorphism from a group G to the invertible linear maps of a vector space; here over the complex numbers, not assumed finite-dimensional or continuous.
The complex group algebra C[G]: finite formal combinations of group elements with convolution product; a representation of G extends to an algebra homomorphism from C[G] (asAlgebraHom).

finite group: central idempotent of a group algebra
An element e of C[G] with e*e = e whose coefficient function g -> e(g) is a class function (equivalently e is an idempotent in the centre of C[G]). In a unitary representation of a finite group it acts as an orthogonal projection commuting with G.
group: group algebra; idempotent element; class function

An element e of a ring with e^2 = e.
A field with finitely many elements; its number q of elements is a prime power. (The corpus has existence/uniqueness theorems for finite fields but the index shows no plain definition knowl.)

finite group: additive character of a finite field
A group homomorphism psi from the additive group of a finite field k to the nonzero complex numbers. It is nontrivial iff primitive in Mathlib's sense; for nontrivial psi the sum of psi(w.x) over x in k^n is q^n if w = 0 and 0 otherwise (orthogonality).
The group GL_n(R) of invertible n x n matrices over a commutative ring R; used here over finite fields, local fields and the complex numbers.
A complex vector space with a positive definite hermitian form; convention of the Lean source: conjugate-linear in the first variable, linear in the second.
A basis of an inner product space of pairwise orthogonal unit vectors.
The self-adjoint idempotent linear map onto a (closed) subspace; in the Lean source a linear map p with p^2 = p and <px,y> = <x,py> (IsSymmetricProjection).
For a linear map A : S -> T between finite-dimensional complex inner product spaces, the unique linear map A* : T -> S with <A x, y> = <x, A* y> for all x, y.
The trace of an endomorphism of a finite-dimensional vector space: the sum of the diagonal entries of its matrix in any basis; tr(AB) = tr(BA).
In finite dimension every linear map is Hilbert–Schmidt; its Hilbert–Schmidt norm is the square root of tr(A*A) = sum of |A b_i|^2 over an orthonormal basis, and <A,B> = tr(A*B).
group: inner product space; orthonormal basis; adjoint of a linear map; trace

|<x,y>| <= |x| |y| in an inner product space.
dim ker A + dim im A = dim V for a linear map on a finite-dimensional space.
group: linear map; dimension of a vector space

The cardinality of a basis; in the Lean source finrank, which is 0 for a space that is not finite-dimensional. Grassmann formula dim(F+G) + dim(F cap G) = dim F + dim G.
The tensor product of two complex vector spaces; for inner product spaces it carries the inner product <c⊗u, c'⊗u'> = <c,c'><u,u'>.
For an endomorphism T and a scalar c, the subspace of x with T x = c x; eigenspaces for distinct c are independent.
det(X - T) for an endomorphism T of a finite-dimensional space.

Over a field of characteristic 0 the traces tr(T^l), l >= 0, of an endomorphism of a finite-dimensional space determine its dimension and characteristic polynomial (power sums determine elementary symmetric functions). Used in the form: equal traces of all powers on two spaces imply equal characteristic polynomials.
The determinant of a square matrix or of an endomorphism of a finite-dimensional space; additive in each row; det of block triangular matrices is the product of the diagonal blocks.
The transpose of the cofactor matrix of a square matrix A, with A adj(A) = det(A) 1; the (i,i) entry is the determinant of A with row and column i removed. Cramer's rule: A^{-1} = adj(A)/det A.
The determinant of the upper left l x l block of a square matrix.
For vectors v_1..v_m and a hermitian (or sesquilinear) form h, the matrix (h(v_a, v_b)); for a matrix Y of columns and the form with matrix J it is Y* J Y. Its determinant is the Gram determinant.

From vectors v_1, v_2, ... in an inner product space, the orthogonal vectors o_a = v_a - sum_{b<a} <o_b,v_a>/|o_b|^2 o_b (no normalisation; terms with o_b = 0 omitted). span(o_1..o_a) = span(v_1..v_a).
The norm sup |A x|/|x| of a matrix for the Euclidean (l2) norms; submultiplicative, |A*| = |A|, |A A*| = |A|^2, entries and columns are bounded by it.

A map h : V x V -> C on a complex vector space, conjugate-linear in the first and linear in the second variable, with h(w,v) = conj h(v,w). Given by a hermitian matrix J as h(v,w) = v* J w. A vector is isotropic if h(v,v) = 0; a hyperbolic pair is (e, e*) with h(e,e) = h(e*,e*) = 0, h(e,e*) = 1.
A complex square matrix equal to its conjugate transpose.

finite group: unitary group of a hermitian form
The group U(J) of invertible matrices g with g* J g = J for a hermitian matrix J (isometries of the form); for J of signature (p,q) the real Lie group U(p,q). The corpus knowl lie-groups/unitary-group covers only the compact U(n).
An upper triangular square matrix with all diagonal entries 1; block version: equal to the identity on and below the diagonal blocks of a level function.

For a nondegenerate hermitian form on a finite-dimensional space over a field with involution, every isometry between two subspaces extends to an isometry of the whole space. Form used: two tuples of vectors with the same invertible Gram matrix are related by an element of the unitary group.
group: hermitian form; unitary group of a hermitian form; Gram matrix

A left invariant Radon measure on a locally compact group, unique up to scalar; here on U(kappa) (probability measure), on the real unitary group G_1 (normalised by the Cayley chart, New.haarU) and on unipotent groups (image of Lebesgue measure).
The translation invariant measure on R^n normalised on the unit cube; on C^n via real and imaginary parts.

finite group: quotient measure on a homogeneous space
For a closed unimodular subgroup U of a unimodular locally compact group G, the measure on U\G with int_G f = int_{U\G} int_U f(u y) du dy. In the Lean source it is realised as a measure on G (Haar measure weighted by a cutoff, New.orbitMeasure) that integrates left U-invariant functions over U\G.

finite group: polar coordinates on a complex vector space
Lebesgue measure on C^k is pi^k r^{k-1}/(k-1)! dr dh under x = h sqrt(r) x_0, r = |x|^2 > 0, h in U(k) with Haar probability measure, x_0 a unit vector.

finite group: Sobolev trace inequality on a cube
The value of a function at a corner of a cube of side eps in R^d is bounded in mean square by eps^{-d}-weighted mean squares over the cube of the function and of its iterated first-order partial derivatives (one per coordinate). Exact form used: Lean lemma New.sobolev_trace_cube with constant (2/eps (1 + (N Lambda)^2))^d.

finite group: Schwarz lemma for bounded holomorphic maps
A holomorphic map f on a ball of radius r in a complex normed space, bounded in norm by B, satisfies |f(p) - f(c)| <= (2B/r) |p - c| for p in the ball, c the centre.

finite group: spectral theorem for commuting normal operators
A commuting family of normal operators on a finite-dimensional complex inner product space has a basis of joint eigenvectors. Form used: New.IsUnitary.le_span_hecke_eigenvectors for the Hecke operators T_{w,i} at split places in a unitary representation.
A totally imaginary quadratic extension E of a totally real number field E+; complex conjugation is a well defined automorphism of E and acts on its places.

finite group: finite place of a number field
A nonzero prime ideal of the ring of integers (equivalently a nonarchimedean place), with completion E_w, ring of integers O_w, uniformiser and finite residue field F_w. For a CM field the place w is split if it differs from its complex conjugate.
group: number field; prime ideal; residue field

finite group: infinite place of a number field
An archimedean place: a real embedding or a pair of conjugate complex embeddings.

For a CM field E and rank n: the group G_f of finite adelic points of the unitary group of a hermitian space of rank n over E; at a split place w it contains GL_n(E_w) (acting at w and its conjugate). K_0 is the standard maximal compact subgroup (stabiliser of the standard lattice).
group: CM field; finite place of a number field; adele ring; unitary group of a hermitian form

The kernel of reduction modulo given finite places on the integral points K_0 of an adelic group; here J_M = levelOf(chosen places, trivial subgroup), with K_0/J_M (at the chosen places) the product of GL_r of the residue fields.
group: finite adelic unitary group; residue field

finite group: automorphic form on a unitary group
In the Lean source (Space.Form): functions on the adelic points of the unitary group of a hermitian space V over a CM field, left invariant under rational points, of a prescribed archimedean type (a reproducing kernel typeKernel l s for the discrete series of doubled Harish-Chandra parameter l and signs s), with the right translation action formRep of G_f and the Petersson inner product. Forms of level K are the K-fixed vectors (levelSpace).
group: finite adelic unitary group; discrete series representation; Harish-Chandra parameter

The L2 inner product of two automorphic forms over the adelic quotient G(E+)\G(A) with respect to an invariant measure; the action of G_f by right translation is unitary for it.
group: automorphic form on a unitary group; Haar measure

For a unitary group that is compact at all infinite places: functions on the finite adelic points with values in an algebraic representation (weight), equivariant under rational points and invariant under a level K. For a small level their space has dimension (number of double cosets Gamma\G_f/K) x (dimension of the weight).
group: finite adelic unitary group; double coset

For subgroups Gamma, K of a group G, a set Gamma g K; the double cosets partition G.

For the standard hermitian lattice of rank l over a CM field: the sum over the classes in its genus (double cosets Gamma\G_f/K_0) of 1/#Aut, where Aut = Gamma ∩ g K_0 g^{-1}. In the Lean source: mass E l = classSum of the constant 1.
group: double coset; finite adelic unitary group

For a compact open subgroup K of a locally compact totally disconnected group and a double coset K g K = union of g_i K: the operator v -> sum rho(g_i) v on K-fixed vectors. At a split place w, T_{w,i} is the operator of diag(pi 1_i, 1_{n-i}) in GL_n(E_w) (New.heckeSplit); the Hecke polynomial at X is sum_i (-X)^i q^{i(i-1)/2} T_{w,i}.
group: finite adelic unitary group; double coset; group representation

The convolution algebra of compactly supported bi-K-invariant functions for a maximal compact K; commutative for unramified groups. In this area a variant is used: elements of a group algebra that preserve K-fixed vectors in every representation (New.universalLevelAlgebra).

For a discrete series representation of U(p,q) of rank n: a regular n-tuple lambda in (n-1)/2 + Z (distinct entries), together with the signs of the diagonal form; the Lean source uses the doubled parameter l = 2 lambda in Z^n. 'Gap h' (HasGap): entries distinct, of the parity of n-1, and entries with different signs differ by at least 2h in l.
group: discrete series representation; unitary group of a hermitian form

An irreducible unitary representation of a real reductive group occurring discretely in L2(G), i.e. with square integrable matrix coefficients.

For a discrete series representation pi of a unimodular group G with Haar measure dg: the number d_pi with int |<pi(g)u,v>|^2 dg = |u|^2|v|^2/d_pi. In the Lean source: the reciprocal of the integral of |c_lambda|^2 for the normalised coefficient c_lambda (dsCoeff). Harish-Chandra: it equals Weyl's dimension polynomial of the parameter (for the measure haarU).
The dimension of the irreducible representation of U(n) with Harish-Chandra parameter lambda is prod_{i<j} (lambda_i - lambda_j)/(j - i) (for decreasing lambda).
group: unitary group of a hermitian form

A comparison of traces of Hecke operators on spaces of automorphic forms of two inner forms of a group, valid for test functions that are cuspidal at one place (so that only elliptic terms occur). Exact form used: New.trace_eq_of_isCuspidalAt (unitary groups over a CM field with different signs at the infinite places, discrete series parameter with large gap).
group: automorphic form on a unitary group; Hecke operator; cuspidal function on a finite general linear group

finite group: cuspidal function on a finite general linear group
A function on GL_n(F_q) (or its inflation to GL_n(O_w)) whose sums over all cosets of the unipotent radical of every proper standard parabolic subgroup vanish. Characters of cuspidal representations (Green's characters of primitive/irreducible labels) are cuspidal.
group: general linear group; finite field; unipotent radical

Expresses the Petersson norm of a theta lift as a series over cosets of matrix coefficients of the Weil representation times matrix coefficients of the form (doubling method). Here only the shape of the series is used: terms mc(gamma) <z, gamma y> (New.SiegelWeil.cosetTerm).
group: Weil representation; theta lift; Petersson inner product

For a unitary group and a subgroup R = U ⋊ H (U unipotent, H the unitary group of a smaller definite space), functions transforming on the left by a generic character of U and by a representation of H (Bessel functions; generalised Whittaker functions). In the Lean source: New.IsBesselFunction on the real group G_1.
group: unitary group of a hermitian form; unipotent radical

The sum over a discrete group (modulo a stabiliser) of translates of a function with prescribed transformation behaviour; here Poincaré series built from Bessel functions, whose Petersson products unfold to sums of orbital (amplitude) integrals.
group: automorphic form on a unitary group; Bessel model

An endomorphism commuting with an irreducible complex representation is a scalar. In BesselSystem this conclusion is taken as the definition of irreducibility of the type rep.
Orthogonality relations for characters of a finite group; for the additive group of k^n: sum over x of psi(w.x) vanishes unless w = 0.
The image of a measure under a measurable map.

For measures mu on X, nu on B and a map pi : X -> B, the disintegration 'd mu / d nu' over a point b. The Lean source uses only the one-sided notion LeFibreMeasure: l is at most the fibre measure over b if for lower semicontinuous K >= 0, int_{pi^{-1} S} K d mu <= C nu(S) for all small open S around b implies int K dl <= C.
